title: A Space Rock Exploded Over Siberia and Flattened 80 Million Trees

scenes.text: In 1908, something exploded over Siberia and flattened 80 million trees.
The blast covered about 830 square miles.
It exploded in midair, miles above the ground, so there was no crater.
Scientists think a space rock about 50 meters wide broke apart in the sky.
The trees fell outward from the center, like spokes on a wheel.

description:
In 1908, an object exploded over Siberia and flattened about 80 million trees across roughly 830 square miles.
It blew up in the air, so it left no crater.
Could it happen again?
first_comment: No crater, 80 million trees down. What do you think was it?
